template:
<style>
    :root {
        --primary: #2BC78C;
        --secondary: #1FA670;
        --text: #333333;
        --bg: #F5F7FA;
        --danger: #FF6B6B;
        --border: #E1E4E8;
        --modal-bg: #FFFFFF;
    }

    /* Reset & base */
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
        box-sizing: border-box;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
    }

    body {
        font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
        background: var(--bg);
        color: var(--text);
        padding-top: 4rem;
    }

    /* Navigation */
    nav {
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        background: var(--primary);
        color: #fff;
        height: 4rem;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 0 2rem;
        gap: 1rem;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
        z-index: 100;
    }

    nav button {
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        color: #fff;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
        border-radius: .50rem;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        font-weight: bold;
        transition: background .2s;
    }

    nav button:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .2);
    }

    /* Grid & cards */
    .container {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
        gap: 2rem;
        padding: 2rem;
    }

    .card {
        background: var(--modal-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: .20rem;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, .05);
        overflow: hidden;
        transition: transform .3s, box-shadow .3s;
    }

    .card h2 {
        padding: 1rem;
        background: var(--secondary);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 1.25rem;
    }

    .card-content {
        padding: 1rem;
    }

    /* Tables */
    table {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        margin-bottom: .5rem;
    }

    th,
    td {
        padding: .75rem 1rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    th {
        background: var(--primary);
        color: #fff;
        text-align: left;
    }

    tr:nth-child(even) {
        background: var(--bg);
    }

    tr:hover {
        background: rgba(80, 227, 194, .1);
    }

    .cell-yes {
        background: var(--secondary);
        color: #fff;
        text-align: center;
        border-radius: .25rem;
    }

    .cell-no {
        background: var(--danger);
        color: #fff;
        text-align: center;
        border-radius: .25rem;
    }

    .btn {
        display: inline-block;
        padding: .5rem 1rem;
        background: var(--primary);
        color: #fff;
        border: none;
        border-radius: .25rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        font-size: .9rem;
        margin-top: .5rem;
        transition: background .2s;
    }

    .btn:hover {
        background: #1FA670;
    }

    td[data-copyable="true"] {
        user-select: text;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: background .3s;
    }

    td[data-copyable="true"].copied {
        background: rgba(43, 199, 140, .2);
    }

    /* Colonnes fixes pour versions & flows */
    #table-versions,
    #table-flows {
        table-layout: fixed;
        width: 100%;
    }

    #table-versions th:nth-child(1),
    #table-versions td:nth-child(1),
    #table-flows th:nth-child(1),
    #table-flows td:nth-child(1) {
        width: 50%;
        text-align: left;
    }

    #table-versions th:nth-child(2),
    #table-versions td:nth-child(2),
    #table-flows th:nth-child(2),
    #table-flows td:nth-child(2) {
        width: 50%;
        text-align: center;
    }

    /* Bordures de tableau en overlay */
    #card-overlay table {
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: .25rem;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, .12);
    }

    #card-overlay table tr:first-child th:first-child {
        border-top-left-radius: .25rem;
    }

    #card-overlay table tr:first-child th:last-child {
        border-top-right-radius: .25rem;
    }

    #card-overlay table tr:first-child th,
    #card-overlay table thead th {
        border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
    }

    #card-overlay table th,
    #card-overlay table td {
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    #card-overlay table th:last-child,
    #card-overlay table td:last-child {
        border-right: none;
    }

    /* Toast copie */
    #copy-toast {
        position: absolute;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .75);
        color: #fff;
        padding: .3rem .6rem;
        border-radius: .25rem;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity .3s;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 1100;
    }

    #copy-toast.show {
        opacity: 1;
    }

    /* Overlay modal */
    #card-overlay {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
        backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        visibility: hidden;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity .2s;
        overflow: auto;
        z-index: 1000;
    }

    #card-overlay.show {
        visibility: visible;
        opacity: 1;
    }

    #card-overlay .modal {
        background: var(--modal-bg);
        margin: auto;
        overflow: visible;
        width: auto;
        max-width: 95vw;
        max-height: 95vh;
        border-radius: .5rem;
        box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3);
        display: block;
        text-align: left;
    }

    #card-overlay .modal-header {
        background: var(--primary);
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        position: relative;
        padding: 1.25rem 1rem;
        border-top-left-radius: .5rem;
        border-top-right-radius: .5rem;
    }

    #card-overlay .modal-header span {
        font-size: 1.5rem;
        font-weight: bold;
        color: #FFFFFF;
    }

    #card-overlay .modal-close {
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        right: 1rem;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        font-size: 1.5rem;
        color: #000;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    #card-overlay .card-content {
        padding: 1.5rem;
        overflow: auto;
        max-height: calc(95vh - 4rem);
    }

    /* Centrage de la colonne initiale Flow */
    #table-groups th:nth-child(1),
    #table-groups td:nth-child(1) {
        text-align: center;
    }
    /* 1. La modal doit autoriser le scroll dans les deux axes */
    #card-overlay .modal {
    overflow: auto !important;
    }
    
    /* 2. Le container interne scroll horizontal & vertical */
    #card-overlay .card-content {
    overflow-x: auto !important;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    }
    
    /* 3. Supprime toute coupure forcée */
    #card-overlay table {
    white-space: nowrap; /* empêche le retour à la ligne */
    }
    
    /* 4. Assure-toi que l’overlay peut lui-même scroller si nécessaire */
    #card-overlay {
    overflow: auto !important;
    }

    /* 1. On supprime tout forçage de largeur fixe sur la modal et son contenu */
    #card-overlay .modal {
    width: auto !important;
    max-width: 95vw;
    max-height: 95vh;
    overflow: hidden; /* on gère le scroll dans .card-content */
    }
    
    /* 2. On fait de .card-content la zone scrollable, horizontale & verticale */
    #card-overlay .card-content {
    max-height: calc(95vh - 4rem); /* prend toute la hauteur dispo */
    overflow-x: auto; /* scroll horizontal */
    overflow-y: auto; /* scroll vertical */
    }
    
    /* 3. On autorise le tableau à déborder pour déclencher le scroll */
    #card-overlay .card-content table {
    width: auto !important; /* le tableau peut s’étendre */
    min-width: 100%; /* ou au moins la largeur du container */
    table-layout: auto; /* laisse le navigateur déterminer */
    }
    
    /* 4. Assure-toi que l’overlay peut scroller si besoin */
    #card-overlay {
    overflow: auto !important;
    }

    /* 1) Supprime le scroll interne dans .card-content */
    #card-overlay .card-content {
    overflow: visible !important;
    max-height: none !important;
    }
    
    /* 2) Active le scroll sur l’overlay seulement */
    #card-overlay {
    overflow: auto !important;
    }
    
    /* 3) Garde la modal centrée */
    #card-overlay {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start; /* ajuste si tu veux partir du haut */
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 2rem 0; /* espace en haut/bas */
    }
    
    /* 4) Laisse la modal s’adapter à son contenu */
    #card-overlay .modal {
    max-height: none !important;
    }
</style>
